description: Anticipated bottleneck is nearest-history lookup. Doc proposes 'pub trait SpatialIndex' with brute-force/KD-tree/R-tree backends (kiddo, rstar). WORKSPACE RULE OVERRIDES: (a) enum dispatch, not trait objects; (b) any new third-party dep goes in the ROOT [workspace.dependencies] only; (c) kiddo/rstar must be checked for Android/Termux compatibility before adoption. Scaffold brute-force + reuse of the existing uniform spatial-hash grid first; tree backends deferred behind not-implemented variants so no dep is added prematurely.
title: outram-mc: SpatialIndex abstraction for history lookup (design doc s16)
